interviewNotes.section1: Freelance web dev 4 years. Clients: travel agency, painter, entertainment, shipping company (part-time, 9 months). Built lead gen and workflow automation for shipping company.
interviewNotes.section2: No deep industry from birth/family. Closest is home services from painting client. Interested in contractor gorilla model.
interviewNotes.section3: Knows conversion over aesthetics. Trust signals: forms, team photos, awards, trust badges, instant call buttons. Learned ugly but clear beats pretty but confusing.
interviewNotes.section4: Online communities only. No warm US network. No referral partners yet.
interviewNotes.section5: $400 max project. All one-off. No recurring revenue yet. Plans land-and-expand: site + SEO first, then upsell automation.
interviewNotes.section6: Wants direct owner relationships. No middlemen. No solar. No corporate/agency politics.
interviewNotes.section7: Full-time. $0 ad budget. Scores: web design 5, automations 4.5, SEO 4, content 2, sales 1. Target: $20-25k/month in 12 months.
